_doc: Standard source clips for a new monster. Generate each with `python -m creature_pipeline prompt "<action>"` (adds framing, locked cameras and the subject-only rule) from the monster's two-view start frame, Wan 3.0 Prime, 6 s, 720p, 16:9. Replace 'four-legged' if the body plan differs. Lessons from Voltusk are folded into the wording.

idle.action: IDLE: the creature stands in place breathing slowly, chest rising and falling, small head turns and a lazy tail sway, occasional weight shift between legs. Feet stay planted.

walk.action: WALK CYCLE ON A TREADMILL: the four-legged creature walks forward with a natural quadruped gait, diagonal leg pairs alternating, each foot reaching well forward and the planted feet sliding back under the body as if on a treadmill belt, body bobbing gently, head nodding, tail swaying. It stays centered in each panel. The cycle loops cleanly.

run.action: RUN CYCLE ON A TREADMILL: the four-legged creature runs at full speed with a powerful bounding gallop, long strides, front and hind leg pairs reaching far forward and pushing far back as if on a fast treadmill belt, spine flexing, head low and aggressive, tail streaming behind. It stays centered in each panel. The cycle loops cleanly.

walk_back.action: WALK BACKWARD ON A TREADMILL: the creature faces forward and walks backward: each foot lifts and is placed down BEHIND where it was, and the planted feet slide forward under the body toward the head, as if on a treadmill belt moving toward its head. Diagonal leg pairs alternate, head low, watchful. It stays centered in each panel. The cycle loops cleanly.

strafe_left.action: SIDESTEP LEFT ON A TREADMILL: the creature keeps its body and head facing straight forward and steps sideways to its own left: each foot lifts and is placed down further to its left, and the planted feet slide toward its right under the body, as if on a sideways treadmill belt. Legs cross over, alert stance. It stays centered in each panel. The cycle loops cleanly.

strafe_right.action: SIDESTEP RIGHT ON A TREADMILL: the creature keeps its body and head facing straight forward and steps sideways to its own right: each foot lifts and is placed down further to its right, and the planted feet slide toward its left under the body, as if on a sideways treadmill belt. Legs cross over, alert stance. It stays centered in each panel. The cycle loops cleanly.

attack.action: HORN STRIKE: the creature crouches, draws its head back, then drives forward with one powerful horn headbutt, holds the strike for a beat, then recovers to its stance. One strike only.

bite.action: BITE: the creature rears its head back with jaws wide, lunges forward and snaps its jaws shut hard once, then pulls back to its stance with the mouth closing. One bite only.

jump.action: JUMP: the creature crouches deep, then all four legs push off together and it leaps straight up, fully off the ground with all four feet in the air at the same time, legs tucked, then lands on all four feet with a deep squash and rises back to its stance. It jumps in place.

stomp.action: REAR AND STOMP: the creature rears up on its hind legs, front legs high, then slams both front feet down hard onto the ground in front of it, holds the impact, then settles to its stance.

dodge.action: DODGE: the creature tenses, then explosively hops sideways to its left, all four feet leaving the ground, lands low in a defensive crouch, then hops back to the center and settles into a ready stance. Sharp, snappy timing.

special.action: SPECIAL ATTACK: the creature crouches low, launches itself into the air, does one full 360-degree spin while airborne, then crashes down head-first and slams the ground in front of it, holds the impact pose for a beat, then recovers. It stays roughly in place.

hurt.action: HURT REACTION: the creature flinches as if struck hard on the head by an unseen blow, head snapping back and to the side, body recoiling backwards and stumbling back two short steps, mouth open in pain, then it shakes it off and plants its feet back in its ready stance.

faint.action: KNOCKOUT: the creature staggers, wobbles side to side, its legs buckle, the front legs fold first, then the whole body collapses onto its side on the ground, head drops, tail goes limp. It lies completely still for the rest of the clip.

roar.action: ROAR / POWER UP: the creature plants its feet, lowers its head, then rears up its front body and throws its head back in a huge roar with the jaw wide open, chest out, tail lifted, holds the roar, then settles back onto all fours in its ready stance.
